name: The Works
description: Act 2, chapter `engram` (STORY.md §16): the `the-works` mission, Engram's forward foundry on Maren. A grey cratered moon; a road (painted Engram orange) runs north from our landing through `works-gate` to a raised, levelled apron where the chassis hall stands (`chassis-hall`: the same hull as our Command Core under orange paint, event `same-hands`, then `engram-offer`). Two more levelled terraces west and north-east of the apron are left empty for Engram's outposts. East, a lumpy dark slag field with a dumped hull (`slag-field`). No wildlife (packs ×0, open spawn, 30 min grace): "a thousand ways to fight and no reason to". Engram is a faction here (team 3, neutral): sensor masts at the gate, the chassis hall (a Vehicle Bay behind chassis-hall) with printers, fusion cells, a lab, radar and repair pad on the apron, solar and batteries on the west terrace, an airpad on the north-east terrace, a deep mine in the slag; polite drones on the road, the apron, the terrace and the slag (Scouts, Skiffs, Rovers as stand-ins). Expedition: 800 alloys, 3 drones, 3 Rovers, 2 Lancers.
